title: Virtual Casino
overview:
It's Las Vegas In Your Living Room

When Lady Luck calls, you can't always drop everything and hop on the next plane to Atlantic City or Monte Carlo. Don't worry, though - there's an open table waiting for you on the Virtual Casino floor. Whether your game is Black Jack, Baccarat, 7 Card Stud, Roulette or that one-arm bandit known as the Slot Machine, you'll feel the excitement as the money starts to stack up. Best of all, when your luck runs out, your supply of chips won't!

You'll see and hear the flip of the cards and the clank of the coins!
